effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if they have no unsuspended Digimon, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Angoramon] in its text, it gets +2000 DP.
